name: Speaker Display — Air Quality Critical Alert
description: When the air quality gateway publishes a 'critical' status (CO₂ > 1000 ppm or PM2.5 > 35 μg/m³), override the live data display with a red scrolling alert and set system.airquality_alert so the normal display rule is suppressed until the space is safe.
